Container lạnh

An insulated, temperature-controlled ISO shipping container equipped with a refrigeration unit for transporting perishable cargo such as food, pharmaceuticals, and chemicals.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Container lạnh?

In this glossary, Container lạnh refers to: An insulated, temperature-controlled ISO shipping container equipped with a refrigeration unit for transporting perishable cargo such as food, pharmaceuticals, and chemicals.

How is Container lạnh used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Việc vận chuyển hàng tươi sống cần container lạnh để duy trì nhiệt độ kiểm soát trong suốt chuỗi vận chuyển."

Why does Container lạnh matter in logistics?

Container lạnh matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Modes contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Container lạnh?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An insulated, temperature-controlled ISO shipping container equipped with a refrigeration unit for transporting perishable cargo such as food, pharmaceuticals, and chemicals.

Operational example

The shipment of fresh produce requires a reefer container to maintain a controlled temperature throughout the entire transport chain.
